lines.text: 如果你是鸟，那我也是鸟。
lines.en: If you're a bird, I'm a bird.
lines.note: 雨中与湖边的儿戏誓言：恋恋笔记本用一句对称告白，把一生折叠成鸟的翅膀。通行定译。

lines.text: 我是个普通人，想法普通，过得平凡。但有一件事我做到了极致：我全心全意爱过一个人。对我而言，这就足够了。
lines.en: I am nothing special, of this I am sure... But in one respect I have succeeded as gloriously as anyone who's ever lived: I've loved another with all my heart and soul, and for me, that has always been enough.
lines.note: 写给艾莉的读信独白（节选）；IMDb quotes 可查。

lines.text: 这不容易，会非常难。我们得每天面对彼此。但我想要这样——因为我想要你。我要全部的你，永远，每一天。
lines.en: So it's not gonna be easy. It's gonna be really hard... But I wanna do that, because I want you. I want all of you, forever, every day.
lines.note: 雨中争吵后的挽留名段；IMDb quotes 可查。
